collision_support.method: collision-support-v1: Geometry/Roadway/View-Geometry only; 0..0.08m below; 12cm footprint and 50cm vertical clearance; building roof and eight wall rays; stock proxy tables only; proxy marker faces excluded; no visual fallback

generation_partitions.method: complete disjoint sorted stock-group round robin; full original stock pin in every partition

sources.method: ODOL56 visual horizontal face support with 12cm footprint; bounded decoded visual/collision proxy tables, composite interior and exposed cabinet tiers; proxy marker faces excluded; raw building frame, restored furniture centres; 0.10m candidate lattice and measured prop centres snapped to mesh tops; 5mm lift; Z-edge-first plane ordering with .60m separation; collision and reach audits before spacing/cap including full optional-prop item/body volumes, swept corridor and eye obstruction; optional props never support; final collision-only support/enclosure gate (see collision_support)

prior_overlay_selection.method: re-audit both sets; prefer larger passing layout then append compatible points; same spacing/caps/categories
prior_overlay_selection.prior_method: ODOL56 visual horizontal face support with 12cm footprint; bounded decoded visual/collision proxy tables, composite interior and exposed cabinet tiers; proxy marker faces excluded; raw building frame, restored furniture centres; 0.15m candidate lattice and measured prop centres snapped to mesh tops; 5mm lift; edge-first plane ordering with .60m separation; collision and reach audits before spacing/cap including full optional-prop item/body volumes, swept corridor and eye obstruction; optional props never support; final collision-only support/enclosure gate (see collision_support)

prior_reach_generation.refusal_counting: collision support/enclosure, then visual/room/clearance/reach; stop on refusal; all checks before spacing/cap; final read-only audit collects all reach reasons

reach_generation.refusal_counting: collision support/enclosure, then visual/room/clearance/reach; stop on refusal; all checks before spacing/cap; final read-only audit collects all reach reasons
